question: Sodium Hydroxide is the chemical name of which of the following common substances?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Caustic Soda.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sodium hydroxide** is also known as **caustic soda**, which is a **strong base** commonly used in the manufacture of **soaps, detergents, and paper.**
 
• **Bleaching powder,** also known as** calcium hypochlorite,** is a **strong oxidizing agent** used for **disinfection and bleaching** purposes.
 
• **Borax,** also known as **sodium borate**, is a naturally occurring mineral used in **laundry detergents **and as a **cleaning agent.**
 
• **Chalk, **also known as **calcium carbonate, **is a soft, white, porous sedimentary rock used in making cement, as a dietary supplement, and in **toothpaste.**
 
• **Sodium hydroxide** is a **highly corrosive substance** and can cause severe burns if it comes in contact with the skin.
 
• Therefore, it must be** handled with care.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bleaching powder **is a compound used for **disinfection purposes.**
 
• **Borax **is a naturally occurring mineral used in laundry detergents and as a** cleaning agent**. 
 
• **Chalk **is a soft, white, **porous sedimentary rock **used in various applications.
